title: Yesterdays
author: Nisha Raviprasad
text:
My yesterdays lay
soaked in cheap perfume
and salty memories
waves of hope
rode through my head.
they swam in random
despair
in silly desires,
in the broken moon
and blue waters in the backdrop.
my yesterdays
were a handful of droopy daisies,
how choked was I
when my heart swell in shame.
Today has dawned
the blue waters are serene
daisies have bloomed
the broken moon is resiliently beautiful
for on silence

have I learnt to flourish.
